subject: Redwood POC: quickstart checklist & next steps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@acmeai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0000
Subject: Redwood POC: quickstart checklist & next steps

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet you and James on the call earlier. Quick recap + suggested next steps so we can get the POC feeding data into the model within the week: 

- What we demonstrated: low-latency embedding pipeline and sample reranking flow tuned for short queries.
- Your stated goal: reduce search latency for product docs to <150ms 95th while keeping retrieval relevance >= current baseline.
- POC scope we agreed: ingest ~250k doc snippets (subset), run embedding + rerank, and instrument latency/quality dashboards.

Immediate asks for your infra team to unblock the kickoff:
1) Whitelist Redwood outbound IPs for the connector (I attached a short whitelist table).
2) Provide a test S3 bucket or temporary credentials we can use for the initial ingest.
3) Confirm whether traffic needs to go through your corporate proxy (if yes, we will provide proxy-friendly connector settings).

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf (quickstart + example curl), poc-action-item.csv (mutual action plan).

If it's helpful I can hop on a 20-min pairing session with your infra engineer — I find 15–20 min screenshares remove the stalls faster than long threads. Suggested times: Mon/Tue morning PT.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivEk@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Samantha —

Just bumping this in case the whitelist/credentials request got buried. We haven't seen the S3 or network confirmation yet and the onboarding slot we held for this week is opening up.

If the timing has shifted on your side, totally understand — can you let me know where this ranks right now (green / yellow / red)? If green, can we schedule a short pairing session to complete the network step? If red, we can pause the slot and pick a new date.

Also, small offer: if the network config is the only blocker, we can run a local ingest on our side with a synthetic subset and let you validate results before you open credentials — that sometimes speeds validation.

—V

Hi Vivek —

Apologies for the radio silence. We're blocked on our side: corporate security requires that outbound IPs be vetted through our network team and they opened a ticket last week. I don't yet have the OK to share the test S3 credentials until that completes.

James is copied — he owns the ticket and estimated the earliest we could proceed is next Wed (17th). If that timeline slips it's probably because the security team will ask for additional documentation.

We would like to continue the POC but timing is not firm. A short pairing session with our infra engineer could help clarify what the security team needs.

Thanks for the update, Samantha — and no worries on timing. Two quick things to keep momentum and remove the friction: 

1) I've attached a short network-troubleshooting-checklist.txt that maps the exact outbound IP ranges, expected ports, and the minimal transport we need. If you can pass that to your security team it usually answers the initial questions quickly.

2) If James' ETA of Wed 17th holds, let's tentatively schedule a 20-min pairing slot on Thu 18th at 10am PT so we can finish the connector setup and kick off ingest. If that doesn't work, suggest a one-hour window for pairing the week of 22nd.

3) To avoid losing test momentum, we're happy to provision a short isolated test that uses a synthetic subset (no credentials required) so you can see the end-to-end flow and dashboards. Let me know if you'd like that while the security ticket is open.

If helpful I can also loop in our security lead (Sergio) to a short sync with your network team — Sergio, can you join a 20-min call with Acme infra if they ask for it?

Appreciate the update — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
